{"predictors": [
    {"name": "Earnings Surprise Momentum", 
     "construction": "Change in earnings surprise (last 4 quarters earnings per share - analyst estimates) over the last 4 quarters", 
     "rationale": "Firms that consistently beat earnings estimates may have strong underlying growth or superior management",
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"}, 
     
    {"name": "Dividend Increase Frequency", 
     "construction": "Number of dividend increases over the last 10 years", 
     "rationale": "Firms that consistently increase dividends may have strong cash flows and be investor-friendly", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "CEO Tenure Return", 
     "construction": "Cumulative stock return during current CEO's tenure", 
     "rationale": "Long-tenured CEOs who have delivered strong returns may continue to outperform", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Red Flag Ratio", 
     "construction": "Number of 'red flag' events (restatements, SEC investigations, lawsuits) over the last 5 years divided by total revenue", 
     "rationale": "Firms with a high ratio of 'red flags' to revenue may have governance or operational issues", 
     "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Industry Sentiment Shift", 
     "construction": "Change in industry sentiment (average analyst rating) over the last year", 
     "rationale": "Firms in industries where sentiment is improving may outperform", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Product Cycle Momentum", 
     "construction": "Change in sales over the last year divided by number of new product introductions", 
     "rationale": "Firms that can efficiently drive sales through new products may have competitive advantages", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Social Media Sentiment", 
     "construction": "Positive to negative sentiment ratio on social media platforms over the last quarter", 
     "rationale": "Companies with positive sentiment on social media may have strong customer loyalty and brand value", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Shareholder Yield", 
     "construction": "Dividends plus share repurchases divided by market capitalization", 
     "rationale": "Firms that return a high proportion of capital to shareholders may outperform", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Employee Satisfaction", 
     "construction": "Average employee rating on online job review sites", 
     "rationale": "Firms with high employee satisfaction may have better morale and productivity", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
     
    {"name": "Green Score", 
     "construction": "Environmental sustainability score from third-party ESG rating agencies", 
     "rationale": "Companies with strong environmental practices may be better positioned for future regulatory and societal changes", 
     "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"}
]}
